title: Evori Font Display with Bird Illustration
coreRelationships: The large cream text 'EVORI' dominates the lower half of the composition, serving as the primary subject.
A small, stylized bird is positioned directly on top of the 'O' in 'EVORI', creating a playful interaction.
The solid reddish-orange background provides a strong, contrasting canvas for the cream text and the bird.
The small, condensed text in the top left and top right corners provides contextual information without detracting from the main visual elements.
reuseFormula: Render a bold, condensed, sans-serif word in a high-contrast color against a solid, saturated background. Place a small, flat-design, black and orange bird illustration on top of one of the letters, ensuring the bird's eye creates a subtle directional gaze. Add minimal, small-scale text in the upper corners for context.
